script.problem: It has 40 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.

terra.problem: “Sells her body” is unclear and may suggest that the woman sells her body itself. Say “a woman who is paid to have sex” instead.
In card 10, “harlot” describes Nineveh as a city that seduces and betrays nations. The meaning given covers turning from God to idols, but not this use.
